Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical handbook page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
Sign colors and shapes are taught from the handbook's lists only; the sign images on the page were not described beyond their printed captions [A02].
The pedestrian-signal page distinguishes a flashing hand with a countdown, a flashing hand without one, and a steady hand; the three cases were kept separate exactly as printed [A05].
The center-turn-lane distances carry a statute number in the handbook; the rule is restated without copying statute text [A06].
The school-zone page shows a sample sign with example times and a sample emergency phone number; those sample values are illustrations and were not taught as rules [A07].
Work-zone fine increases are stated without amounts; no amount is asserted.
